=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:22467-22469,22570-22579 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The comments fetch in `stall_recovery_clarify_answer` (22578) and `extract_recommended_answers` (22468) uses `?sort=created&direction=desc&per_page=50`. The issue-comments endpoint ignores sort and direction, so this returns the oldest 50 comments, not the newest.
  WHY: On issues with more than 50 comments the helper can pick a stale round's `/answer` as `source=reasserted`, or parse the wrong questions, which is the decision-flip the PR sets out to remove. Severity is MAJOR in all four reviews, mapped here to high. Confidence ranged 3 to 5.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:22595 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The selection jq requires the `[auto-answered-by-orchestrator|poller]` marker, so a trusted human `/answer` without that marker is ignored.
  WHY: The human decision is silently replaced by the RECOMMENDED letters, which contradicts "RECOMMENDED letters are the fallback only". Severity is MAJOR in both reviews, mapped here to high.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:22604-22621 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: Only the first `/answer` line is stripped from the picked comment. A prior re-assertion's italic note stays in the payload and the caller wraps it in another note.
  WHY: Notes stack on each stall-recovery attempt. Decisions are preserved and growth is bounded by the recovery budget, so this is cosmetic (NIT in all four reviews).
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:22629-22637 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: If `mktemp` or the file write fails, the fallback calls `extract_recommended_answers` without the prefetched file, which makes a second comments API read. minimax_minimax-m3 adds that there is no trap or cleanup for the temp file.
  WHY: This contradicts the documented "one comments read" budget in the function header and the changelog. The path is fail-safe, so this is NIT.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:25484 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The new `BACKPRESSURE_CLEARED tracking_issue=... reason=project_complete` line has a different field set from the existing emitter at 5787.
  WHY: Log parsers see a record missing the measurement fields. The prefix stays stable, so this is minor drift (NIT).
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:17208-17209,21818-21819 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `printf ... | head -n 1` under `set -euo pipefail` can take SIGPIPE on a payload larger than the pipe buffer, giving status 141 and aborting the tick.
  WHY: The re-asserted payload can reach 65536 characters, and the repo already avoids this pattern in `scripts/review_autofix_step_evaluate_gate.sh:27` (NIT).

  WHY: On issues with more than 50 comments, an earlier round's trusted `/answer` can count as newer than the stale question comment. The helper then returns `source=reasserted` and re-posts that round's decisions against the current questions.

Its docstring and the agents.md fragment claim "the 50 newest".
  WHY: With more than 50 comments the helper sees the oldest batch and picks an old `/answer` as `source=reasserted`. If no `/answer` is in the window, the RECOMMENDED fallback parses the same oldest-50 page. The tests stub `gh` (tests/test_plan_auto_answer_recommended_parser.py:795) and never use more than a handful of comments.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:22595 (callers 17210-17227, 21820-21833) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4

  WHY: The human's `/answer Q1: B` is replaced by a posted `/answer [auto-answered-by-poller]` with RECOMMENDED letters. The newest `/answer` wins downstream, which contradicts "RECOMMENDED letters are the fallback only".

  WHY: This contradicts the documented one-read API budget, and the leaked file holds a JSON copy of the comment thread. Both paths are fail-safe.
